decisions.statement: A track uri is `spotify:track:` followed by letters and digits.
A uri of any other shape names no track.
A query named beside an artist is searched ten hits deep.
A query named beside no artist is searched five hits deep.
A query resolves to the first candidate the artist wanted leaves.
A query no track answers is a data error.
A device named on the command line is the device acted on.
A device is looked for only where nothing is playing already.
The device looked for is the one Spotify calls active.
A device with an id is taken where Spotify calls no device active.
No device left to take is an operational error.

definition: the track and the device a play command acts on
